# The second of two bills paid by one transaction, naming its own split.
#
# What this fixture produces: this bill settled from the 200.00 split, with
# both costs now on the payable and the director owed 300.00.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
bill "BILL-TWO-B"
  vendor_id: "V-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-03-02
  entry:
    date: 2026-03-02
    description: "More supplies"
    account: "Expenses:Supplies:USD"
    quantity: 1
    price: 200
    taxable: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-03-02
    due: 2026-04-02
    ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD"
    memo: "Bill BILL-TWO-B"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-03-02
    amount: 200
    account: "Assets:Due From Director USD"
    Transaction "0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0cddeeff0011"
      PaymentSplit "2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0cddeeff00110e1f"
